chunks: Ahmad ibn Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'd ibn Malik ibn al-Ahwas, al-Ash'ari, Abu Ali, al-Qummi.
I have seen books from him: the book of the reasons for the fast, a large (book), the questions of the men (masa'il al-Rijal) to Abu al-Hasan the Third (peace be upon him) that he compiled.
